newsitem.title: GERMANY: German banking watchdog shuts down small bank.
newsitem.headline: German banking watchdog shuts down small bank.

text.p: The German Federal Banking Authority said on Tuesday it was suspending retail operations at the BVH Bank fuer Vermoegensanlagen und Handel AG in Duesseldorf.
The banking watchdog said it made the move because it discovered the bank's writedowns on risky lending were so large they would exceed the institution's liable equity.
The move also necessary to protect the bank's creditors, the authority added.
BVH Bank declined to make any immediate comment.
